cases.rationale: Two equally relevant rows in separately normalized tables. The code row earns real inverse document frequency from its twelve non-matching neighbours while the docs row starts alone at zero, so the merged raw-BM25 order begins code-first. Growing the docs table with unrelated rows must not reverse them, because neither row's content changed.
